name: Bank branch energy benchmark models
description: Benchmark models/dataset representing typical energy consumption patterns of bank branches under different climate conditions for evaluation and comparison of energy models.
reputation: An academic, domain-specific benchmark published in a peer-reviewed venue (Journal of Building Engineering) with moderate adoption in the building energy research community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on energy/time-series modeling; domain-specific (bank branch energy) and may be relatively small with seasonal and climate biases; requires domain expertise for proper preprocessing and evaluation.
